title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: Bias refers to the error introduced by approximating a real-world problem, which may be complex, by a simplified model. Variance refers to how much the model's predictions would change if we used a different training dataset. Consider how adding more data points might affect these aspects.

title: Effect of More Data on Bias
text: Adding more data points generally helps the model learn better patterns from the data, which can reduce bias. Think about how having more examples might help the model make more accurate predictions.

title: Effect of More Data on Variance
text: How does increasing the number of data points typically affect the variance of a model?
choices: It has no effect on variance.
